//: Template for a deployed environment. Copy the shape, never the values. Every entry below marked REPLACE_ must come from an environment variable or a secret store - nothing in this file is a working value.

Jwt.//Key: At least 32 characters. Startup fails outside Development if this is missing, too short, or still the placeholder below.

RefreshToken.//SecureCookie: Must stay true anywhere the app is reachable over a network.

//Seed: Leave seeding off outside Development. With no passwords configured the seeder creates no accounts, so a deployed environment cannot acquire well-known logins by accident.
//Database: Migrations are applied deliberately during deployment, not as a side effect of a process starting.

Cors.//AllowedOrigins: Explicit origins only. A wildcard is invalid here because the refresh cookie requires credentialed requests.
